children: Samantha Mckinney, a Director, reported two open-market sales on 2026-09-01 at weighted average prices of $149.74 and $150.30 per share. The transactions disposed of 6,250 and 3,500 shares, respectively, for a combined total sale amount of $1,461,925. Following the reported transactions, Mckinney directly owns 7,280 shares of Common Stock. Full breakdowns of the number of shares sold at each separate price are available upon request as noted in the filing.
